body.name: Minimum-cost value-path certificate
body.construction: Choose nonactual values \(s_i\in R(P_i)\setminus\{a_{P_i}\}\) for \(0\le i\le m\); for every \(i\ge1\), choose a row \((s_{i-1},b_i)\) such that \(s_i\in A_{P_i}(s_{i-1},b_i)\) and \(\operatorname{Safe}_i(D_i(b_i))\), and charge exactly \(\sum_i\sum_{q\in D_i(b_i)}c(q\to P_i)\).
